gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: --- range() tests: non-calendar-specific fields fall through to the default ChronoField range ---
ADDED i3: --- range() tests: calendar-specific fields return custom Symmetry454 ranges ---
ADDED i4: --- date manipulation: applying a date as its own TemporalAdjuster returns an equal date ---
ADDED i5: --- eraOf() with an out-of-range value throws DateTimeException ---
ADDED i8: --- getId() returns the expected Symmetry454 calendar identifier ---
ADDED i9: --- date(Era, ...) with a null era throws ClassCastException ---
ADDED i12: --- dateNow(Clock) returns the same date as Symmetry454Date.now(Clock) ---
ADDED i13: --- dateYearDay(Era, year, dayOfYear) with dayOfYear out of valid range throws DateTimeException ---
ADDED i16: --- eras() returns both BCE and CE eras ---
ADDED i17: --- zonedDateTime(TemporalAccessor) converts an OffsetDateTime to a Symmetry454 zoned date-time ---
ADDED i18: --- dateNow() and dateEpochDay() return CE-era dates ---
ADDED i19: --- getCalendarType() returns null because Symmetry454 has no LDML calendar type identifier ---
ADDED i20: --- dateNow(ZoneId) returns a CE-era date when a specific zone is provided ---
